title: Trading Card and full-field expression
thesis: A Mez trading card is a portable full-field product object: the product material owns the chassis, the public product name owns the reading order, and the exact Wings appear only where identity needs them. It may stand alone, turn over to carry useful product information, or join a measured deck that explains product relationships. It is not an edition, a rarity token or a decorative reskin.
inherits: public product name first, extended system name second and supporting job third
rounded outer geometry and flat internal joins
filled primary actions in product-led placements
canonical F8, white and contained-charcoal rooms
one automatic Deep Mineral No. 5 Living Core per viewport
exact static twins for repeated, reduced-motion and failed-runtime contexts

meaning.single: A portable identity and orientation object for one Mez Systems product.
meaning.back: A structured second surface for capabilities, sequence, proof or access information that earns a card metaphor.
meaning.pair: Two cards show a direct operating relationship or before-and-after handoff.
meaning.deck: Three or more cards communicate an actual family, suite or ordered operating layer.
meaning.omit: Omit the card when ordinary type, a simple product mark or a functional Product Card 02 component communicates the job more directly.

anatomy.field: one canonical product gradient fills the complete material chassis
anatomy.contrast: use a controlled charcoal scrim, quiet solid nameplate or protected contrast zone; never rely on drop shadow
anatomy.identity: public product name is largest, extended system name follows, supporting job is optional
anatomy.wings: white exact Wings may be centred, mark-above or supporting-corner according to composition
anatomy.interaction: no manual animate button; no card flip is required to understand essential content

motion.eligible: one focal front field in the most visible specimen
motion.fallback: exact source-derived static twin with no layout shift

families.title: Card Faces
families.job: Preserve the four face compositions approved in Round 02 without adding decorative formats.

families.title: Information Backs
families.job: Rebuild useful orientation, sequence, waitlist and quiet reverse surfaces without fake scores, stats, codes or rarity language.

families.title: Decks and Packs
families.job: Define when card relationships communicate architecture, sequence or a real package.

families.title: Website Placements
families.job: Preserve six approved placements and resolve the remaining suite-feature composition.

prohibited: founder foil, rarity or scarcity ladders
fake scores, ranks, attributes or statistics
white outline strokes on charcoal objects
ambient glow, glass or shadow as premium shortcuts
extended system name before public product name
